skills.name: Lore about a magical creature type

items.name: Arbalest
items.description: This large and well-made crossbow requires some training to use effectively, but it's assembled with a cutting-edge firing mechanism that maximizes its speed, power, and accuracy.

items.name: Whip
items.description: This long strand of thick leather, often braided, delivers a painful but nonlethal slash at a distance, usually accompanied by a distinctive cracking sound.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

generalAbilities.name: Scent (Imprecise) 30 feet
generalAbilities.description:
See rules...

Scent involves sensing creatures or objects by smell, and is usually a vague sense. The range is listed in the ability, and it functions only if the creature or object being detected emits an aroma (for instance, incorporeal creatures usually do not exude an aroma).

If a creature emits a heavy aroma or is upwind, the GM can double or even triple the range of scent abilities used to detect that creature, and the GM can reduce the range if a creature is downwind.

generalAbilities.name: Warning Ears
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger The lucky courser rolls initiative using Perception or Survival

Effect Their expressive ears twitch in alarm, granting allies within 10 feet a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls.

defensiveAbilities.name: Guide to Fortune
defensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger The lucky courser or an ally within 10 feet fails a Reflex save, Acrobatics check, or Athletics check

Effect The triggering creature rerolls the save or check and uses the better result.

offensiveAbilities.name: Elusive Hunter
offensiveAbilities.description: The lucky courser can Hide and Sneak in any natural terrain and in lesser cover from allies.

offensiveAbilities.name: Feline Skirmish
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The lucky courser can Interact to reload their arbalest, Step, and Strike, taking the actions in any order. The Step ignores difficult terrain.

offensiveAbilities.name: Head Shot
offensiveAbilities.description: The lucky courser Creates a Diversion and then Strikes. The target is Dazzled until the end of the lucky courser's next turn on a successful Strike (or Blinded on a critical hit).
